annotation.title_clean: Remarks on Artificial Intelligence (AI) Regulation While Encouraging Innovation
annotation.title_en: Remarks on Artificial Intelligence (AI) Regulation While Encouraging Innovation
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ntshavheni, K. (Minister of Communications & Digital Technologies, South Africa)
annotation.summary_en: Speech by South Africa's communications minister at the 2021 Africa ICT Ministers Forum in Windhoek. It urges coordinated African AI participation, a continental AI Blueprint, and human-centred, multistakeholder regulatory frameworks aligned with OECD and ITU AI for Good principles. It questions whether Africa can regulate AI without a clear policy position.
key_provisions_or_claims: Calls for a unified African approach and AU AI Blueprint drafted with Smart Africa Alliance
Proposes regulatory frameworks that are data-centric, human-centred, multistakeholder and anchored in localised agencies
Urges adoption of OECD AI Principles and ITU AI for Good recommendations
Suggests AI Centres of Excellence with regional centres
Mentions deploying AI and robotics in mining to prevent disasters
